overall_summary: Analysis of 14 Shorts reveals that content focusing on 'self respect' (specifically centered around chat interactions, blocking, deleting, and muting) consistently outperforms broader topics like 'रात के ख्याल' or abstract 'अधूरी मोहब्बत'. View counts are generally low across the board (5 to 40 views), but self-respect tactical hooks attract the highest relative baseline views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like AfaLxMy6FMY ('उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' - 40 views), aNR94Xxn0yM (27 views), and wFimeeP_aVc ('ब्लू टिक्स आज छिपा दिए' - 34 views) outperform abstract emotional statements.
winning_patterns.action: Focus future scripts on concrete smartphone actions related to boundaries and self-respect.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on passive themes like 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (uIbMpCjVutQ) received only 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive atmospheric tropes; anchor every emotional observation to a tangible phone or digital boundary action.
